evidence_checks.excerpt: To complete the Python Programming course, submit all four graded labs, achieve at least 70% overall, and earn a Pass on the capstone project.
Graded labs account for 60% of the course mark.
The capstone project accounts for 40% of the course mark.
Submit each lab through the LMS Assessments area as a ZIP archive containing Python source files and a short README.
Upload the capstone to the Capstone submission slot. Include your Python source, test files, and instructions for running the project.
Python Programming is a six-week foundation course for new programmers.
Learners write and debug small command-line programs, organize code into reusable functions, and read structured files.
Weeks 3 and 4 cover functions, modules, files, exceptions, and debugging.
Week 5 introduces unit tests and code review.
A capstone resubmission is available once after written feedback.
The completion record appears in the LMS Results area after the course coordinator verifies the conditions.
